procedure_name: High Security Registration Plate (HSRP) & Color Sticker
summary: Mandatory tamper-proof aluminum number plate with chromium hologram and laser-etched serial code.

steps.title: Book online on BookMyHSRP portal
steps.description: Enter vehicle registration number, chassis number (last 5 digits), and engine number.

steps.title: Choose fitment location
steps.description: Select preferred authorized automobile dealership or opt for home doorstep installation service.

steps.title: Pay government approved fee
steps.description: Make online payment for laser-etched front/rear plates and fuel color sticker (blue/orange/green).

steps.title: Fitment by technician
steps.description: Technician removes old non-standard plates and affixes HSRP plates using non-reusable snap locks.

steps.title: Automatic Vahan status update
steps.description: Technician scans laser barcode; Parivahan Vahan portal automatically updates HSRP compliance status.
